GMB.note: Court testimony on a card serial number; no authentication service stated.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Operator mentioned only as the Immigration Department's ID card unit; no maintenance or ownership arrangement stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: Gambia Immigration Department's Assistant Commissioner Momodou Jallow, officer in charge of the National ID Card unit for four years, told a court on 15 October 2026 that National ID cards carry a name number, a document number and a serial number held in the National ID Card system database.
